head: c8f2e905fa68ca80a5a707c63a95d652c1f1ac32
authorship: Reviewer authored journal changes, not the physical recovery/lifecycle/vendor implementation reviewed here.
method: Complete text review of physical_recovery.rs, lifecycle changes and thin borrowed-FD CONNECT wrapper; inspect existing open/receipt and actual linux caller/retirement paths. No build, test, runner, USB or QEMU execution.

facts.finding: ManualOnly denied before OS observations. Auto owner path requires same boot, recognizes missing/reused PID only with preserved starttime semantics, treats matching zombie as present, and propagates unknown/invalid observations.

Full fingerprint/bus/receipt/configuration/interface-set/alternate scope checked. Only missing originally nonempty drivers are allowed; original None must remain None, usbfs/usbip-host/different driver all reject before CONNECT.

Whole state reobserved before each CONNECT and afterward; a sibling already restored by earlier probe is skipped. Actual syscall errno retained when restoration remains unverified; errno alone is not treated as success. A syscall error converges only when expected driver actually appears within allowed scope, then final complete equality still required.

Independent B uses existing protected fixed-path open, not dup A or nusb Device::from_fd. Newly opened receipt must match saved baseline, then full state is reobserved. All result paths drop B; successful path drops it before verify(false), which rejects gone generation and performs two full baseline observations.

Partial progress, wrong-driver result, changed receipt/scope or observation failure returns error. No detach/rollback or baseline rewrite. Caller retires only on restore success while real blocking closure retains helper mutation guard.

Linux-only safe API borrows BorrowedFd, wraps only existing attach_kernel_driver and maps actual rustix errno to io::Error. It owns no FD, device object, event task or control request; selected kernel driver probe may itself perform USB I/O, as documented.

evidence_gaps: Current product implementation has not been compiled or exercised by this reviewer. Parent central Cargo checks and actual product opt-in SIGKILL/restoration/new-I/O QEMU are still required before runtime success can be claimed.

Seven injected recovery tests, one owner observation test and one /dev/null errno wrapper test exist as source; none were run by this reviewer. They do not establish real USB recovery or guardian shutdown behavior.
Vendor provenance report was read and all seven author-frozen file identities independently matched; this review did not independently rerun the upstream70-file/patch reconstruction.
preserved_scope_limits: CONNECT may select a different driver; post-observation rejects that state without trying to detach it.
External root TOCTOU, arbitrary retained FD/EP0 activity and cancellation of kernel-internal blocking work remain outside this restricted contract.
No cross-configuration/alternate recovery, replacement-generation operation or auto acknowledge-gone is claimed.
